RETRY.name: RETRY
RETRY.desc: Survives one lethal hit per battle at 1 HP.

MEMORY_LEAK.name: MEMORY LEAK
MEMORY_LEAK.desc: Drains 1/16 of the foe's HP each turn.

GHOST_PROCESS.name: GHOST PROCESS
GHOST_PROCESS.desc: Takes half damage from the first hit it receives.

QUICK_BOOT.name: QUICK BOOT
QUICK_BOOT.desc: Moves first on its first turn out.

BACKGROUND_TASK.name: BACKGROUND TASK
BACKGROUND_TASK.desc: Heals 1/16 HP each turn while waiting in the party.

PACKET_LOSS.name: PACKET LOSS
PACKET_LOSS.desc: Foe's moves miss more often (x0.85 accuracy).

DEEP_CACHE.name: DEEP CACHE
DEEP_CACHE.desc: Takes 40% less damage at full HP.

STATIC_SKIN.name: STATIC SKIN
STATIC_SKIN.desc: 30% chance to OVERLOAD attackers that hit it.

ROOT_ACCESS.name: ROOT ACCESS
ROOT_ACCESS.desc: Own moves ignore the foe's stat boosts.
